taxonomy:
# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. Cell Coloring/Shading Puzzles
### A. Pure Shading (no additional constraints)
- Kurodoko
- Nurikabe

### B. Shading with Clue Numbers
- Akari
- Kurotto
- Nurimisaki
- Nurimeizu

### C. Shading with Region Constraints
- Heyawake
- Norinori
- Ripple Effect
- Shakashaka
- Yajilin

### D. Shading with Polyomino Placement
- LITS
- Shakashaka

## II. Polyomino Tiling Puzzles
### A. Irregular Polyominoes
- Fillomino
- Shikaku

### B. Specific Polyomino Sets
- Evolomino
- LITS
- Nuritwin

### C. Tetromino/Pentomino Based
- Chained Block
- Five Cells

## III. Path & Loop Puzzles
### A. Single Continuous Path/Loop
- Hashiwokakero
- Hebi
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Slitherlink

### B. Multiple Paths/Loops
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Nagareru
- Numberlink

### C. Path Avoidance
- Hitori
- Sashigane

## IV. Constraint Satisfaction & Deduction
### A. Elimination-Based
- Hitori
- Sudoku
- Usowan

### B. Clue-Based Deduction
- Juosan
- Nansuke
- Satogaeri
- Suraromu

### C. Region & Group Logic
- Yosenabe

## V. Coloring & Division Puzzles
### A. Two-Color Systems
- Makaro
- Moon-or-Sun
- Tilepaint

### B. Multi-Region Division
- Satogaeri

## VI. Specialized/Hybrid Mechanics
### A. Stacking & Depth
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Sto-stone

### B. Mixed Mechanics
- Kurodoko (shading + region detection)
- Pencils (path + shading)

---

**Note:** Some games appear in multiple categories where their mechanics span multiple puzzle types (e.g., LITS involves both polyomino placement and shading constraints).
